verdict.rationale: The vendor says it lets you "compute your bill before you talk to us" and compare one-to-one against current managed ClickHouse spend, which implies a self-serve cost estimator. A free developer tier with stated limits (up to 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM) and a free cost audit are also documented. However, no actual unit rates, billing dimensions or calculator details appear in the evidence, so how clearly a monthly bill can be estimated is unproven. missing for 10: published per-unit pricing (compute/storage/egress rates), documented billing dimensions, evidence of the calculator's inputs and outputs, independent corroboration that estimates match real bills
